_help: Settings for the nightly build. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_extra_schemes: AMFI scheme codes to track even if they don't match the filters above, e.g. an IDCW fund you hold.
_risk_free_rate: Used only for the Sharpe ratio. 0.065 = 6.5% a year.
